content.text: {"label":"unknown_demand_surge","explanation":"General volume is running +26% to +68% above forecast since 08:45, spread across all reasons (loan_enquiry, login_issue and balance_enquiry about 1.4-1.6x). AHT is near forecast. The only incident is a resolved P3 overnight batch delay, there is no marketing entry, and no absences are logged, so no specific cause is established. Payments is also running above forecast (+29% at 09:45) and fell to 65% service level. That is partly because 3 cross-skilled agents were moved to general, leaving payments below the 70% donor floor. General is currently at 100% service level with 31 agents on phones, against 23 planned.","plan_name":"Shore up payments now, sustain general after noon","rationale":"General is healthy for now thanks to the 09:15 actions, but those actions end around 11:45-12:00 while the surge looks persistent. A modest overtime offer on payments arrives at 10:30. For general, a follow-on overtime offer and an IVR callback extension cover the period after the current actions expire. Chat deflection on high-volume simple reasons trims demand on both queues.
